_total_size: 3.6 MB (flat CSV/JSON — appropriate for this scale; no DB needed)
_note: Storage is flat files by design: 3.6 MB loads in <2s. Parquet/DB would add opacity and overhead with no benefit at this scale. Management is handled by this manifest + the validator (validate_data.py), not by a database.

base_areas.csv.known_issue: Specialty-crop columns (TOMA, OVEG, and formerly COTT/OLIV/WINE) contain synthetic placeholder values, not observations. COTT and OLIV corrected to real geography. TOMA/OVEG still placeholder — replace with Eurostat apro_cpshr.

animal_numbers.csv.shape_note: 245 -> 248: the three Irish regions (IE04, IE05, IE06) were missing because CAPRI's NUTS-2013 Irish codes did not map onto NUTS-2016. Added by tools/build_ireland.py. The old 245 recorded the defect, not the intended shape.

variable_costs.csv.note: Region x activity matrix, used per-region by the supply model. Crop-specific via CAPRI TOIN-ratio redistribution (group area-weighted means preserved). 39 cells are CALIBRATED rather than observed - see sources/residual_cost_calibration.json.

world_prices.csv.source: CAPRI FAO_agg_17_defaulta p_dataMarket 'World'.'PMRK'.<product>.'BAS' (base-period world market price); per-commodity mapping and previous values in sources/world_price_provenance.json
world_prices.csv.note: Replaced 2026-10: the previous values ('CAPRI SUA') differed from CAPRI's base world prices for most commodities, and the oilseed rows held CAKE prices. OOIL, OLIV, FATS, OFOD_M, WMLK kept (no unambiguous CAPRI counterpart).

trade_flows.csv.note: Recalibrated from CAPRI capmod res_0_1717 (2017). The previous 841-row matrix carried a zero diagonal - no intra-EU trade at all - so every commodity showed a 100% extra-EU import share. 547 rows is fewer because CAPRI reports only realised flows, not an exhaustive grid of zeros. | REBUILT 2026-10 on CAPRI's trade partition (sources/capri_trade_regions_2017.json): no EU or rest-of-world double counting, genuine regions no longer dropped, six oilseed-product columns; EU imports match CAPRI's NONEU rows exactly.

supply_elasticities_regional.csv.note: Rebuilt from estnlp PELA 2005 with CAPRI's dampening rule. The previous file was keyed by CAPRI region codes (228 rows, only 107 resolving to model regions) and was clipped at 4.5 rather than dampened, understating 270 cells.

shape.note: real CAPRI crop fertiliser + manure proxy for animals

livestock_output_coef.csv.note: Marketed product per head: CAPRI's COMI/BEEF/PORK/POUM/EGGS/SGMT/SGMI over elementary activities, divided by this model's head count. Replaces YILD for livestock, which for breeding and suckler activities is not a marketed product.

livestock_revenue_coef.csv.note: Market revenue per head, used instead of price x YILD in livestock net revenue.

nutrients_regional.csv.note: Mineral nitrogen applied per hectare by region and crop. NITF is not an application rate; it equals NRET, a requirement.

capri_own_price_elasticities.csv.note: REFERENCE DATA, not a model input: CAPRI's national MARKET elasticities. The supply model uses the regional PELA values in supply_elasticities_regional.csv.

organic_yield_gap.csv.note: FADN-based organic yield gaps by PESETA macro-region and product group (JRC Seville, SUPREMA).

livestock_intensity_bounds.csv.note: Low- and high-intensity dairy yields: the bounds of the livestock intensity margin.

FITNESS_FOR_USE.json.note: How far each model OUTPUT can be trusted; queried by capri_mod/fitness.py.

landscape_targets_ms.csv.note: CAPRI Green Deal targets by member state.

organic_targets_ms.csv.note: CAPRI Green Deal targets by member state.

capri_ghg_mitigation.csv.note: CAPRI mitigation technologies: shares, emissions under each technology, adoption costs

capri_mitigation_potential.csv.note: CAPRI technical mitigation potential by member state and source

capreg_producer_prices.csv.note: Regional CAPRI market prices (MPRI) by NUTS-2 region; read directly by the loader.

capreg_national_prices.csv.note: National CAPRI prices, the fallback where no regional price exists.

p_REGIO.csv.gz.note: CAPRI regional selection (capreg/regio_data_sel), used for the Saxony and Croatia crop splits.

eu_gross_trade_supplement.csv.source: CAPRI res_2_1730greendeal_refdefaulta dataOut (ImportQ by partner, EXPT-IMPT)
eu_gross_trade_supplement.csv.note: CAPRI's extra-EU gross trade for commodities the trade file does not record (sugar, durum wheat)

land_rent_regional.csv.note: Land rent per hectare by region (Eurostat apri_lrnt, arable land and/or permanent grassland); 2017 or nearest year, regional where published, else national; Germany and Cyprus on a flagged fallback.

capri_baseline_surplus_2030.csv.source: CAPRI res_2_1730greendeal_refdefaulta dataOut(region,'perHa','SURTOT','NITF','2030') (supplied by the project lead)
capri_baseline_surplus_2030.csv.note: CAPRI's own baseline gross N surplus per ha (2030 reference), input to the tiered nitrogen target; 157 regions CAPRI NUTS-2, 82 own pattern scaled to CAPRI national, 9 own (source column).

n_deposition_regional.csv.note: Atmospheric N deposition per ha by region (CAPRI 2030 reference, EMEP-based); 157 NUTS-2, 91 national. Deposition changes slowly; 2030 used for the 2017 base.

manure_trade_2030.csv.source: CAPRI res_2_1730greendeal_refdefaulta dataOut (supplied by the project lead)
manure_trade_2030.csv.note: Manure N trade between regions: export share of excretion, import per ha of cropland

capri_fertiliser_allocation_2030.csv.source: CAPRI res_2_1730greendeal_refdefaulta dataOut (supplied by the project lead)
capri_fertiliser_allocation_2030.csv.note: CAPRI fertiliser allocation per region and crop: need, mineral, manure, residues, losses (calibration data for the allocation module)

capri_regional_n_balance_2030.csv.source: CAPRI res_2_1730greendeal_refdefaulta dataOut (supplied by the project lead)
capri_regional_n_balance_2030.csv.note: CAPRI regional N balance positions (MINFER, EXCRET, MTRADE, IMPORT, EXPPRD, CRESID, BIOFIX, ATMOSD, SURTOT)

fertiliser_substitution_2030.csv.source: CAPRI res_2_1730greendeal_refdefaulta dataOut fertDist_*, nutNed_* (supplied by the project lead)
fertiliser_substitution_2030.csv.note: Manure-N availability and mineral-N efficiency per region (CAPRI fertiliser allocation): manure displaces mineral fertiliser at availability/efficiency; need_at_floor_share: share of crop need at CAPRI's minimum-mineral floor (fert/fertpar.gms p_minShareMinFert: 0.4 arable, 0.5 vegetables/permanent, 0.3 maize, 0.2 silage maize, 0.05 grass, 0 pulses), EU median where unmatched

livestock_manure_n_coef.csv.source: CAPRI 2017 regional results (res_17*.txt, MANN x LEVL), built by tools/build_livestock_output_coef.py
livestock_manure_n_coef.csv.note: Manure N per head (kg), CAPRI 2017 regional manure N total per activity divided by this model's herd (census stock)

livestock_feed_coef.csv.source: CAPRI 2017 regional results (res_17*.txt), built by tools/build_livestock_output_coef.py
livestock_feed_coef.csv.note: Feed per head (t): cereals, protein-rich and energy-rich feed - CAPRI 2017 regional totals (FCER/FPRO/FENE x LEVL) divided by this model's herd

capri_oilseed_products_baseline.json.source: CAPRI FAO_agg_17_defaulta p_dataMarket (year BAS), supplied by the project lead; EU = sum of member states
capri_oilseed_products_baseline.json.note: Base balances of oils, cakes and seeds for the 21 trade regions, EU crushing quantities and yields - Stage 1 of oilseed crushing (docs/OILSEED_CRUSHING.md).

eu_demand_elas_overrides.json.source: CAPRI elas_2_1717defaulta p_ElasDem (supplied by the project lead)
eu_demand_elas_overrides.json.note: EU-row own-price demand elasticities for the oilseed products (EU member-state medians); other regions use armington_params.csv.

feed_demand_nonEU.json.source: CAPRI FAO_agg_17_defaulta p_dataMarket (FEDM/DOMM, BAS) and elas_2_1717defaulta p_ElasFeed (supplied by the project lead)
feed_demand_nonEU.json.note: Non-EU feed demand for the model feed commodities: feed share of use and own/cross feed-price elasticities. EU feed demand comes from the supply models in CAPRI.

_vintage_summary.why_not_newer: A newer base requires CAPRI to RE-ESTIMATE its PMP parameters for the new year (a CAPRI-side computation). Mixing newer prices/quantities onto 2017 PMP terms breaks calibration - the validator blocks this. Trade is separable and safely refreshed to 2021.
_vintage_summary.synthetic: 2 files (feed_requirements, nutrient_coefs) have no real source and use plausible templates. Flagged by validator and at runtime.
_vintage_summary.upgrade_path: See docs/DATA_LOCATION_MAP.md. A newer STAR release database (results) from capri-model.org would provide a consistent newer base.
_vintage_summary.layout: Data organised as capri_data/<base_year>/<category>/ with cross-vintage files in shared/. Market JSON parameter files (fao_market_baseline, fao_processing_splits, fao_demand_own_elas_eu) live in <year>/market/.
